meta.name: browser
meta.description: Drives a real browser through the omowright library from the js eval kernel: sites the user is already signed into, forms and clicks, JS-rendered pages, screenshots, web QA, extension popups, a human handoff for login, CAPTCHA or OTP, and a browser you own for scraping, bot-scored targets, network capture and QA traces. Use for any interactive browser task; not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作真实浏览器完成登录、填表、点击与抓取,并留存截图
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要登录网站抓数据、自动填表或做网页验证。
copy.tagline_en: Automate a real browser for logins, forms, clicks, scraping, and screenshots
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to log into sites to scrape data, fill forms, or run web checks.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 能通过 omowright 操作真实浏览器：在你已登录的浏览器里打开页面、点击、填表、截图、做网页 QA；遇到登录、验证码或短信验证码时把控制权交回你手动完成。
howto.when: 当你要做交互式浏览器任务——例如操作已登录的网站、点击或填表、截图等——时接管；普通搜索或无阻拦的静态抓取不归它管。

say.text: 打开 https://example.com 并截个图
say.note: 用你已登录的浏览器打开并返回截图

say.text: 在我已登录的网站里点开设置页并填表提交
say.note: 先读页面拿到元素引用，再点击、填表

say.text: 这里要登录或验证码，请把控制权交给我
say.note: 暂停自动化，等你手动完成后再继续读页面

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude drives a real browser through omowright: it navigates the browser you are already signed into, clicks, fills forms, takes screenshots and does web QA, and hands control to you for login, CAPTCHA or OTP.
howto.when_en: Triggered for interactive browser tasks such as acting on sites you are signed into, clicking or filling forms, screenshots and web QA. Not for a plain search or an unblocked static fetch.

say_en.text: Open https://example.com and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Uses your signed-in browser and returns a screenshot

say_en.text: On a site I'm signed into, open settings and submit the form
say_en.note: Reads refs first, then clicks and fills

say_en.text: This needs a login or CAPTCHA — hand control to me
say_en.note: Pauses automation until you finish manually
